groupings.title: Explore
groupings.description: Understand the problem and choose the next useful action.

groupings.title: Decide
groupings.description: Prepare the work and preserve consequential decisions and behaviour.

groupings.title: Drive
groupings.description: Carry an agreed outcome through implementation, integration, and assessment.

groupings.title: Assess
groupings.description: Review the relevant behaviour and risks against intent and standards.

groupings.title: Deliver
groupings.description: Package the change and follow through on CI and review.

groupings.title: Continue
groupings.description: Preserve intent and verified state, reconcile observations, and assess usage.

groupings.title: Voice
groupings.description: Write clearly or draft in Alex’s voice for the intended channel.
